description: Paid: $0.05 per call, paid via x402 in USDC on Base. STATUS: planned, not yet available. Checks whether an entity is blocked by operation of the OFAC 50 Percent Rule (owned 50% or more, in the aggregate, by designated persons) even when it does not itself appear on any list. Requires beneficial-ownership graph analysis, not list lookup.
name: screen_ownership_50pct
title: 50 Percent Rule ownership screening
